title: 第153章 灵剑真人再来师妹请跟我回去第152章 六目妖王的野心
slug: 开局被退婚反手娶小姨子
lines: 沧州这边，一切趋向于平静。
时间一天天过去，炼尸门覆灭的动静逐步平息，再也不如之前那样子震动，偌大一个宗门，就这么被覆灭了，不少没有被献祭的人知道了这个消息，自然是很高兴，捡回一条命。
那些人脱离了炼尸门的操控，不需要提心吊胆活着，不少家族很识趣，直接归附于天心宗和积尘宗，属于莽山妖宫的那些地盘内的那些家族，大部分都被献祭了，所剩下的人不多，这些人，都被迁移走了，一部分给天都门，是无灭真人亲自负责的。
另一部分，则是交给了积尘宗，风零真人不再管这些事情，而是派来了几个长老管理这些事情，自然而然和莽山妖宫起了一点冲突，结果嘛，十分凄惨，挨揍了，直接废了。
蓝天圣下手，可不会和他们人类一样，若不是不能够杀了他，当场就杀了，当下他们莽山妖宫和积尘宗天都门还是盟友关系，自然要顾忌一二，不能太过分。
“这些废物可真是嚣张，真以为我是风零真人吗？随便你们呼唤，哼。”
“本王不杀他们，都是给他们面子，下次再敢在本王面前嚣张，本王不介意送你们上路。”
蓝天圣大声威胁道，当面谴责那三个长老，他们不敢吭声，打不过，人数也好，还是实力，都不占据优势，而且，此地是莽山妖宫的地盘，蓝天圣在自己的地盘动手，任何人也挑不出理由。
三位长老灰溜溜离去，不敢再回头，也不敢嚣张，灵剑真人淡淡道：“这几个人可不是善茬，他们实力虽然不怎么样，但是，他们这种人坏事的能力是非常厉害的，小心他们回去之后给你抹黑，然后让积尘宗对你动手。”
蓝天圣嗤之以鼻道：“切，老子怕他们？积尘宗算什么东西？只要天都门不插手，本王都不怕他们。”
积尘宗，还不足以威胁到他，蓝天圣可不怕。
不是谁都是天都龙王，天都门的确强大，那都不是因为天都龙王，寿命补充回来的天都龙王，得到了不少丹药，实力会不断提升，他的恐怖天赋将会再次展现，到时候，他们可以看到更加恐怖的天都龙王，天都门的人也没有积尘宗的那三位那么嚣张。
这三位长老实力不如风零真人，背景也不如无灭真人他们，却比他们都要嚣张，这样的人，敢在他面前放肆，蓝天圣可不会惯着他们，该动手震慑就动手震慑，他不需要给任何人面子。
“你厉害，蓝天圣，你的变化很大，实力提升也很快，可否告知我原因？”灵剑真人亲眼看到蓝天圣的实力变化，提升巨快好不好。
那提升速度，完全是不符合常理，这就到达了问真一重天，而且，还在迅速提升。
求道到问真，此人才用了多长时间，妖兽的修为提升本来就很慢，一重境界，需要几十年上百年才能够提升，这是他们的缺点，不然，寿命漫长，实力强大，还……提升迅速，还有人类什么事情？
蓝天圣的提升速度违背了常理，除非他是老怪物夺舍重生，才有这等提升速度，很明显，蓝天圣并不是。
灵剑真人之前没有仔细关注过蓝天圣，实在是他的变化很大，整个莽山妖宫内部，他的变化是最大的，莽山妖宫的其他妖兽的实力提升也很明显，这种变化，自然瞒不过灵剑真人。
单单是战斗，无法提升这么明显，继续下去，莽山妖宫将会迅速崛起，甚至于会碾压天都门，成为沧州最强的势力，这可不行，必须要想办法知道他们迅速提升修为的秘密。
蓝天圣深深看着灵剑真人，双眸变冷。
“你真的想知道？”
这个秘密，可不能让人类知道，特别是灵剑真人。
灵剑真人皱眉：“自然想要知道，你会告诉我？”
蓝天圣摇摇头：“不会。”
灵剑真人：“……”
不会的话，你问那么多干嘛，这不是消遣我吗？
“蓝天圣，你们的改变很大，而且。”
灵剑真人的话停止了，他们的变化是从那个人来到莽山山脉之后才有的，也就是说，他们的变化和陈初阳有很大的关系，其他人不了解陈初阳，灵剑真人可是很清楚的。
那个小子是个炼丹师，而且，炼丹天赋非常逆天，正好，他也在龙蛇山上，自己可以再去一次。
师妹可是个人才，可不能留在此地浪费天赋。
绑定了师妹，也许可以绑定陈初阳，之前，他的决策出现了问题，导致一切崩盘。
灵剑真人改变策略，不再采用之前的手段，而是换一种方式，或许可以挽回这一切。
他相信，他肯定可以说服师妹，可以说服陈初阳。
“而且什么？”蓝天圣靠近过来，眼里，闪烁一抹杀意。
“没有，没什么。”灵剑真人摇摇头，猜测可不能说出来，也不能暴露，他看向了龙蛇山的方向，问：“蓝天圣，可否带我去龙蛇山一趟？”
蓝天圣眼睛眯成了一条线，盯着灵剑真人，那股杀意，越发明显。
“你不要误会，我是去找我师妹，我师妹你也认识，心然长老，她就是我师妹，而且，我和龙蛇山的主人也算是旧相识，不是去找麻烦的。”灵剑真人连忙解释，他知道这个人动了杀心，若是不解释的话，此人是真的会动手的。
灵剑真人可不想在此地动手，他可以镇压蓝天圣，他无法直面蝶无梦。
此地乃是妖兽的地盘，他可不敢乱来。
再说了，他不是来找麻烦的，自然不会那么做。
“是吗？”蓝天圣十分怀疑。
灵剑真人坚定说：“真的，我去过一次龙蛇山，你不想带的话，可以让开一条路，我自己去。”
他不想招惹麻烦，也不想要和那些妖兽起冲突，蓝天圣可以让那些妖兽不对他动手，他自然不会动手。
“行吧，我带你去，你若是敢有异动，我会杀了你。”蓝天圣威胁道，这个人类不值得信任，看他说得有板有眼，蓝天圣不敢自作主张，若是他说的都是真的话，自己阻拦他，反而会让那两位记恨自己。

content_en:
Here in Cangzhou, everything tends to be calm.
Time passed day by day, and the news of the corpse refining sect's destruction gradually subsided. It was no longer as shocking as before. Such a large sect was just destroyed. Many people who had not been sacrificed knew the news, and were naturally very happy to have saved their lives.
Those people were freed from the control of the Corpse Refining Sect and did not need to live in fear. Many families were very wise and directly attached themselves to the Tianxin Sect and Jichen Sect. Most of the families in the territories belonging to the Mangshan Demon Palace were sacrificed, and there were not many people left. These people were all moved away, and some of them were given to the Tiandu Sect, which was personally responsible for Master Wu Mie.
The other part was handed over to the Jichen Sect. Master Feng Ling no longer took care of these matters, but sent a few elders to manage these matters. Naturally, there was a little conflict with the Mangshan Demon Palace. The result was very miserable. He was beaten and was directly destroyed.
Lan Tiansheng would not attack like they humans. If they were not unable to kill him, they would kill him on the spot. At present, they, Mangshan Demon Palace and Jichen Sect Tiandu Sect are still allies, so naturally they have to be cautious and not go too far.
"These losers are really arrogant. Do they really think I am Master Feng Ling? You can call me whatever you want, hum."
"If I don't kill them, I will give them face. If you dare to be arrogant in front of me next time, I won't mind sending you on your way."
Blue Sky Saint threatened loudly and reprimanded the three elders in person. They did not dare to say a word. They could not defeat them, and they did not have an advantage in numbers or strength. Moreover, this place was the territory of the Mangshan Demon Palace. If Blue Sky Saint took action in his own territory, no one could find a reason.
The three elders left in dejection, not daring to look back or be arrogant. Master Lingjian said calmly: "These people are not good people. Although their strength is not very good, their ability to do bad things is very powerful. Be careful that they will discredit you when they go back, and then let the Jichen Sect attack you."
Lan Tiansheng sneered and said: "Oh, I'm afraid of them? Who is the Jichen Sect? As long as the Tiandu Sect doesn't interfere, I'm not afraid of them."
Jichen Sect is not enough to threaten him, but Lan Tiansheng is not afraid.
Not everyone is Tiandu Dragon King, Tiandu Sect is indeed powerful, but it is not because of Tiandu Dragon King. The Tiandu Dragon King who has replenished his lifespan has obtained a lot of pills, and his strength will continue to increase. His terrifying talent will be displayed again. When the time comes, they can see the more terrifying Tiandu Dragon King. The people of Tiandu Sect are not as arrogant as the three from the Jichen Sect.
These three elders are not as strong as Master Feng Ling, and their background is not as good as Master Wu Mie, but they are more arrogant than them. If such people dare to be presumptuous in front of him, Lan Tiansheng will not tolerate them. If they need to be shocked, they will be shocked. He does not need to give anyone face.
"You are amazing, Saint Blue Sky. You have changed a lot and your strength has improved very quickly. Can you tell me the reason?" Master Spirit Sword has seen with his own eyes the changes in Saint Blue Sky's strength and the improvement has been huge. OK?
The speed of improvement is completely inconsistent with common sense. This has reached the first level of truth-seeking, and it is still improving rapidly.
How long did it take for this person to seek truth and seek truth? The improvement of the cultivation of monsters is very slow. It takes decades or hundreds of years to improve to the first level. This is their shortcoming. Otherwise, they have a long lifespan, strong strength, and... rapid improvement. What else can happen to humans?
Blue Sky Saint's improvement speed goes against common sense. Unless he is an old monster reborn from his body, he can have such an improvement speed. Obviously, Blue Sky Saint is not.
Master Lingjian had not paid close attention to Blue Sky Saint before, but he had changed a lot. He had the biggest change in the entire Mangshan Demon Palace. The strength of other monsters in Mangshan Demon Palace had also improved significantly. Naturally, this change could not be hidden from Master Lingjian.
The improvement cannot be so obvious through fighting alone. If it continues, the Mangshan Demon Palace will rise rapidly, and even crush the Tiandu Sect and become the strongest force in Cangzhou. This is not possible. We must find a way to know the secret of their rapid improvement in cultivation.
Lan Tiansheng looked deeply at the spiritual sword master, his eyes turned cold.
"You really want to know?"
This secret cannot be known to humans, especially Master Lingjian.
Master Lingjian frowned: "Of course I want to know, will you tell me?"
Lan Tiansheng shook his head: "No."
Spirit Sword Master: "..."
If not, why are you asking so many questions? Isn’t this just to entertain me?
"Sage Lantian, you have changed a lot, and."
Master Lingjian stopped talking. Their changes only occurred after that person came to the Mangshan Mountains. In other words, their changes had a lot to do with Chen Chuyang. Others didn't understand Chen Chuyang, but Master Lingjian knew it very well.
That boy is an alchemist, and his talent for alchemy is incredible. It just so happens that he is also on Dragon Snake Mountain, so he can go there again.
Junior sister is a talented person, and she cannot waste her talent by staying here.
By binding the junior sister, maybe Chen Chuyang can be bound. Before, there was a problem with his decision-making, which caused everything to collapse.
Master Lingjian changed his strategy and no longer used the previous methods, but changed to another method, which might be able to save everything.
He believed that he could definitely convince his junior sister and Chen Chuyang.
"And what?" Lan Tiansheng came closer, with a flash of killing intent in his eyes.
"No, it's nothing." Master Lingjian shook his head. He couldn't tell or reveal his guess. He looked in the direction of Dragon Snake Mountain and asked, "Sage Blue Sky, can you take me to Dragon Snake Mountain?"
Lan Tiansheng narrowed his eyes into a thin line and stared at the spiritual sword master. The murderous intention became more and more obvious.
"Don't get me wrong, I'm looking for my junior sister. You know my junior sister, Elder Xinran. She is my junior sister. Moreover, the owner of Dragon Snake Mountain and I are old acquaintances. We are not looking for trouble." Master Lingjian quickly explained. He knew that this person had murderous intentions. If he didn't explain, he would really do it.
Master Lingjian didn't want to take action here. He could suppress Lan Tiansheng, but he couldn't face Die Wumeng directly.
This place is the territory of monsters, and he doesn't dare to mess around.
Besides, he didn't come here to cause trouble, so he certainly wouldn't do that.
"Really?" Lan Tiansheng was very doubtful.
Master Lingjian said firmly: "Really, I have been to Dragon Snake Mountain once. If you don't want to take me with you, you can make way for me to go by myself."
He didn't want to cause trouble, nor did he want to conflict with those monsters. Blue Sky Saint could make those monsters not to attack him, so he would naturally not do anything.
"Okay, I'll take you there. If you dare to do anything wrong, I will kill you." Lan Tiansheng threatened. This human being is not worthy of trust. Seeing that he said it clearly, Lan Tiansheng did not dare to make his own decisions. If what he said was true, if he stopped him, he would make those two people hate him.
